lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₂CuO₄ (VCuO₂) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/a (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms—8 V, 8 Cu, and 12 O—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Cu centers coordinated by four O neighbors and octahedral V centers coordinated by six O neighbors. The same analysis reports corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and V octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between V octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
